# truenas_ftp_config (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS FTP service configuration. Takes no arguments: there is exactly one FTP configuration per TrueNAS system.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `anonpath` (String) Path exposed to anonymous FTP users. "" means unset (API null).
- `anonuserbw` (Number) Anonymous user upload bandwidth in KiB/s (0 for unlimited).
- `anonuserdlbw` (Number) Anonymous user download bandwidth in KiB/s (0 for unlimited).
- `banner` (String) Banner text displayed to clients on connection.
- `clients` (Number) Maximum number of simultaneous connections.
- `defaultroot` (Boolean) Whether local users are restricted to their home directory by default.
- `dirmask` (String) Octal umask applied to directories created via FTP.
- `filemask` (String) Octal umask applied to files created via FTP.
- `fxp` (Boolean) Whether File eXchange Protocol (server-to-server transfers) is enabled.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "ftp_config".
- `ident` (Boolean) Whether IDENT authentication is enabled.
- `ipconnections` (Number) Maximum number of connections per IP address (0 for unlimited).
- `localuserbw` (Number) Local user upload bandwidth in KiB/s (0 for unlimited).
- `localuserdlbw` (Number) Local user download bandwidth in KiB/s (0 for unlimited).
- `loginattempt` (Number) Maximum number of allowed login attempts before disconnecting.
- `masqaddress` (String) Public IP address or hostname to masquerade as for passive connections behind NAT.
- `onlyanonymous` (Boolean) Whether only anonymous logins are allowed.
- `onlylocal` (Boolean) Whether only local user logins are allowed (no anonymous access).
- `options` (String) Extra proftpd.conf options, appended verbatim.
- `passiveportsmax` (Number) Upper bound of the passive port range (0 for default OS-assigned range).
- `passiveportsmin` (Number) Lower bound of the passive port range (0 for default OS-assigned range).
- `port` (Number) Port the FTP service listens on.
- `resume` (Boolean) Whether resuming interrupted transfers is allowed.
- `reversedns` (Boolean) Whether reverse DNS lookups are performed on client connections.
- `ssltls_certificate` (Number) ID of the certificate used for TLS/SSL. 0 means no certificate is set (API null).
- `timeout` (Number) Maximum idle time in seconds before disconnecting.
- `timeout_notransfer` (Number) Maximum time in seconds a client is allowed to spend between transfers.
- `tls` (Boolean) Whether TLS/SSL is enabled for FTP (FTPS).
- `tls_opt_allow_client_renegotiations` (Boolean) TLS option: allow client renegotiations.
- `tls_opt_allow_dot_login` (Boolean) TLS option: allow dot login.
- `tls_opt_allow_per_user` (Boolean) TLS option: allow per-user certificates.
- `tls_opt_common_name_required` (Boolean) TLS option: require a common name in the client certificate.
- `tls_opt_dns_name_required` (Boolean) TLS option: require a DNS name in the client certificate.
- `tls_opt_enable_diags` (Boolean) TLS option: enable diagnostic logging.
- `tls_opt_export_cert_data` (Boolean) TLS option: export certificate data to the environment.
- `tls_opt_ip_address_required` (Boolean) TLS option: require the IP address in the client certificate to match.
- `tls_opt_no_empty_fragments` (Boolean) TLS option: disable empty fragments (workaround for buggy clients).
- `tls_opt_no_session_reuse_required` (Boolean) TLS option: require a new SSL session on data connections.
- `tls_opt_stdenvvars` (Boolean) TLS option: export standard environment variables.
- `tls_policy` (String) TLS policy. One of: on, off, data, !data, auth, ctrl+data, ctrl+!data, auth+data, auth+!data.
